# The Barking Lot

> Professional dog and cat grooming in Richmond, Virginia. All breeds, dogs and cats. "Where a dirty dog is a temporary thing." Owner Steve Boschen has groomed pets in Richmond since 1972; The Barking Lot has served Richmond since 1990.

## Contact and location
- Name: The Barking Lot
- What it is: professional pet grooming shop (dogs and cats, all breeds)
- Address: 606 N Belmont Ave, Richmond, VA 23221
- Neighborhood: on North Belmont Avenue in the Museum District, Richmond
- Phone: (804) 358-4038
- Email: thebarkinglotinrichva@verizon.net
- Website: https://thebarkinglot.info/
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=606+N+Belmont+Ave+Richmond+VA+23221
- Parking: street parking on Belmont Avenue

## Hours (America/New_York)
- Tuesday to Friday: 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM
- Saturday: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Sunday and Monday: closed

## Services
All breeds, dogs and cats. No prices are published; call for a quote.
- Bath and brush: bathing, brushing, blow drying, coat brushing, cologne
- Cuts and styling: clipper cuts, hand scissoring, breed-appropriate styling
- Nails: nail trimming, nail filing, nail grinding (walk-in nail trims until 2 PM; call ahead to confirm)
- Ears and teeth: ear cleaning, ear hair trimmed, ear hair plucked, teeth brushing
- Skin and coat care: dematting, flea dip, medicated bath, specialty shampoos
- Cats: professional cat grooming

## Price information
Prices are not listed online. Call (804) 358-4038 for a quote.

## How to book
- Call (804) 358-4038, or
- Send an appointment request at https://thebarkinglot.info/visit.html#request (a request, not a confirmed booking; the shop calls back to confirm a time)

## Payment
Cash, Visa, MasterCard, debit cards and checks.

## Recognition
- Virginia Living, Best of Virginia 2022: 1st place, Dog Groomer
- Richmond Magazine Editor's Pick, best grooming establishment, 2010
- County Advisory Board "TOP GUN" business professional recognition (Steve Boschen)
- Google rating 4.5 from 141 reviews
- BBB rating A+ (not BBB accredited)

## Community
Supports animal rescue, including Richmond SPCA, Richmond Animal League, Richmond Animal Care and Control, For the Love of Animals (Goochland) and Animal Adoption and Rescue Foundation (AARF).

## FAQ
- Do you groom cats? Yes. "Big or small, we groom them all, cats too!"
- How much does grooming cost? Call (804) 358-4038 for a quote; prices are not published online.
- Do you take walk-ins? Walk-in nail trims until 2 PM (call ahead to confirm). Full grooms by appointment.
- Where do I park? Street parking on Belmont Avenue.
- What are your hours? Tuesday to Friday 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; closed Sunday and Monday.
- What payment do you accept? Cash, Visa, MasterCard, debit cards and checks.
- Do you need vaccination records? Ask the shop about vaccination requirements when you book.
